programme.desc: In women's tennis, the 2025 season culminated with the WTA Finals in Riyadh with the participation of the eight best players. programme.title: Leaders. In the center of the game – Karol Czubak | E05
programme.desc: The series directed by Maciej Klimek presents five PKO BP Ekstraklasa players who took responsibility for their teams at the decisive moments of the 2025/26 season. The heroes are Jesus Imaz (Jagiellonia Białystok), Rifet Kapić (Lechia Gdańsk), Radosław Murawski (Lech Poznań), Julian Shehu (Widzew Łódź) and Karol Czubak (Motor Lublin). Cameras follow them on and off the pitch, showing the pressure, behind-the-scenes of matches and their private lives. The last episode of the series is the story of Karol Czubak. For nine years, no Pole has won the top scorer's crown in the Ekstraklasa. In the 2025/26 season, the Motor Lublin striker had such an opportunity. Czubak comes from a town with only about 150 inhabitants. Over the years, he has consistently worked his way to the top. In his debut season in the top league, he had a chance to fulfill a dream that remains unattainable for many footballers. Poland. 2026. documentary series

(S1): Balls, head and heart» In the 90s, football imposed a model of masculinity based on testosterone and balls; Whoever does not follow it is considered a faggot, the star insult in stadiums that smell like cigars. Women are invisible because they are also invisible in other areas of society and are even prohibited from entering the boxes. Yes, they are present on television, but always as an object woman. In this context, Teresa Rivero becomes the first president of a professional club 'She was a pioneer' Rivero had no idea about football and it was her husband who put her there, but under her presidency Rayo Vallecano lived glorious days and created its women's section. Today, in a society that is improving in the face of machismo and homophobia, female presidents continue to be news, and no footballer in the history of La Liga has yet come out of the closet.

programme.desc: «The league of... (T1): All the president's ultras» The presidents attend, astonished, the appearance in Spain of the ultra fans movement. They don't really know how to relate to them, but they are clear that they don't want them against them. To keep them happy, they give them privileges; After all, presidents are the first fans. Joan Gaspart, former president of the F.C. Barcelona boasts of being one of the Boixos Nois, the ultras of Barça. At the same time, their egos invite them to challenge each other, with cocky attitudes that begin with mockery and end in punches. These presidential attitudes are reproduced in the stadiums: dirty play, insults to the referee and racist chants are the order of the day. In this spiral of violence, the ultras cross the red line with physical attacks that end with the murder of Aitor Zabaleta. This death will mark a turning point, and the presidents will have to decide whether to protect or confront this monster that they themselves fed.

programme.desc: «90 years of LaLiga (2019): Abel Resino» Abel Resino holds the unbeaten record in the history of LaLiga. As an Atlético de Madrid player, he entered the Guinness Book by keeping a clean sheet for 1,275 minutes, which goes from November 25, 1990, in which Claudio scored a goal against him in Mallorca-Atlético and March 17, 1991, on matchday 26, when Luis Enrique managed to beat him in the 45th minute of Atlético-Sporting de Gijón played in Vicente Calderon. A total of 14 consecutive games without conceding a goal in the 1990/1991 season. A mark that is still valid in professional football and that helped him win the Zamora trophy with 17 goals conceded in 33 games. Champion of the Copa del Rey, in 1995 he decided to sign for Rayo Vallecano of Madrid to play his last active season. Abel played a total of 264 games in the highest category of Spanish football

programme.desc: Archaeologists are examining the events surrounding the 1836 Battle of the Alamo, the most famous siege on American soil. Shipwrecks in the Gulf of Mexico reveal the arms trade that foreshadowed the legendary battle. Dir.: Michael Davies, Christopher Riley, Sophie Elwyn-Harris. Led by: Craig Sechler. USA, UK

programme.title: d/f Open Atlantis
programme.desc: James Cameron and Simcha Jacobovitch embark on an exciting adventure in search of the lost city of Atlantis. Using Plato as a virtual treasure map, they explore various hypotheses for the location of the mythical civilization, including Santorini, Malta and southern Spain. A team of professors from the United States, Canada, Israel and New Zealand analyzes archaeological sites and satellite photographs to determine the most plausible versions. The film also examines theories surrounding Gibraltar and the islands of the Azores archipelago, concluding with an analysis of southwestern Iberia as a potential center of an ancient maritime civilization. This investigation offers viewers a unique opportunity to explore one of the greatest mysteries in human history. USA

programme.title: d/f Lost Cities with Albert Lean: The Flood
programme.desc: The famous explorer and documentarian will go on an exciting trip around the world, exploring ancient myths and scientific hypotheses about the Great Flood - an event that gave rise to the legendary stories of different peoples of the world. From the depths of the Black Sea to the snow-capped peaks of Peru, he will reveal amazing archaeological finds to viewers. Dir.: Mike Slee, Rennie Bartlett, Russell England. USA

programme.title: d/s Destruction Decoded (Disasters in space)
programme.desc: You will learn about the 10 worst space accidents - from Baikonur to Cape Canaveral. These failures highlight how high the stakes are in space exploration, and how deeply they are affected by human error and lack of experience. Dir.: Guilain Depardieu. USA

programme.title: d/s Megastructures (FC Real Madrid)
programme.desc: The Santiago Bernabeu is a true temple for Real Madrid fans. We will witness a cutting-edge renovation of the iconic stadium. Dir.: Mike Slee, Jeremy Hall, James Bates. USA

programme.title: d/s Giant sea mechanisms (Who wins)
programme.desc: The series introduces viewers to the most complex maritime operations on the planet, where powerful machines and experienced crews work to the limit of their capabilities. Filmed on oceans, rivers and working coastlines, each episode features how professionals use science, engineering and cutting-edge technology to solve real-life problems on the water. Dir.: Bob Daly, Andrew Killawee, Chris Kingston. Canada

programme.title: d/s Air Crash Investigation (Deadly absent-mindedness)
programme.desc: In 1981, the US Department of Civil Aviation issued the “Sterile Cockpit” Rules, which required pilots to perform the duties associated with operating the aircraft during critical situations on board an aircraft. Dir.: George D'Amato, James Hislop. Cast: Jason Weinberg, Bill Lake, Dennis Akayama, Jerry Mendicino, Hrant Alyanak, Jean-Marc Fontaine, Brendan Wall. Led by: Stephen Bogert, Jonathan Aris. Canada, 2003, documentary

programme.title: д/с Air Crash Investigation. 3 с.
programme.desc: One of the worst nightmares for pilots is a fire on board, which can lead to fatal consequences and horrific loss of life. A thorough analysis of the causes of such disasters can make flying in the sky safer. Dir.: George D'Amato, James Hislop. Cast: Jason Weinberg, Bill Lake, Dennis Akayama, Jerry Mendicino, Hrant Alyanak, Jean-Marc Fontaine, Brendan Wall. Led by: Stephen Bogert, Jonathan Aris. Canada, 2003, documentary

programme.title: t/s Lost Bible Treasures (The Real King Herod)
programme.desc: King Herod is one of the most villainous figures in the Bible. He is blamed for the horrific "massacre of the innocent" in an attempt to kill the baby Jesus Christ. USA

programme.title: t/s Lost Bible Treasures (Secrets of the Tower of Babel)
programme.desc: The famous biblical Tower of Babel, so tall it reached the heavens, surpassed all modern engineering marvels. We want to find out if this tower ever existed. USA

programme.title: д/с Engineering by Catastrophe (После потопа)
programme.desc: Around the world, the risk of flooding, storm surges, and extreme rainfall threaten cities. In Tokyo, vast underground rivers are being dug to combat typhoons; in Valencia, Spain, floods highlight the need for early warning

programme.title: d/s Engineering by Catastrophe (Connecting the Divided)
programme.desc: The Morandi Bridge collapse in 2018 was a global wake-up call, demonstrating that every structure has a lifespan.

programme.title: d/s Autopsy of disasters (Surfside, Kursk, King's Cross)
programme.desc: Why did a residential building in Surfside collapse, burying sleeping residents under the rubble? What caused the deadly fire at King's Cross tube station when it was overcrowded with passengers? Why did the Russian nuclear submarine Kursk sank? USA

programme.title: d/s Autopsy of disasters (“Deepwater Horizon”, “Concorde”, funicular in Kaprun)
programme.desc: Why did the Deepwater Horizon explode? Why did the Air France Concorde plane crash a minute after takeoff? How did it happen that so many died while riding the Austrian cable car inside the mountain in Kaprun? USA

programme.title: America's Wild Seasons: Spring (S1 E1). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. JAV, 2020. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: JAV, Kanada. Год: 2020. S1, Ep1 «America's Wild Seasons»…Across the continent, the land and its wildlife breathe in warmth and renewal. For some animals, courtship rituals begin to heat up as battles for dominance break out. For others, it's the time to tend to brand new lifeThe wilds of America are vast and untamed. Over the course of a year, this immersive documentary series investigates the perils and challenges faced by the animals that inhabit these ferocious wildernesses. Through winter, spring, summer and autumn witness how the ever changing conditions affect life on land, below the waves and in the air. The personalities and characters of certain animals will develop as the series progress and you will find yourself rooting for your favourites to survive as the seasons go by. America's seasons are wild and extreme posing many trails to the varied wildlife that live there. From freezing rains to scorching deserts, the weather is as scary and unpredictable as it could possibly be. Nature documentary seriesDirector: Jeff MoralesCast: Scott McNeil

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School: Born to be Wild (S2 E10). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2019. S2, Ep10
programme.desc: 2019 г. Год: 2019. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2019. S2, Ep10 «Orangutan Jungle School»…Trouble brews when the team makes the final attempt to reunite reluctant mother Dilla with her new baby Delilah. And Alba, the world's only known albino orangutan, amazes her friends with her unique approach to termite foragingCaptivating documentary series that follows the work of the Nyaru Menteng Orangutan Rescue Centre in Borneo, Indonesia, which is the largest orangutan rehabilitation centre in the world. People who work here are dedicated to rescuing orangutans that have been displaced from their habitat or kept as illegal pets, and they do their best to help them adjust and teach them the skills necessary to survive on their own when they return to the jungle. Hear some incredible stories and follow the antics, triumphs and tragedies of a group of orphaned orangutans as they go through «Orangutan Jungle School»Director: Judith CurranCast: Rebecca Parr

programme.title: BẠCH PHÁT MA NỮ - BRIDE WITH THE WHITE HAIR
programme.desc: Đệ tử Thiên Sơn Yu Luo Sha thách thức bốn giáo phái lớn và giết chết các thủ lĩnh của họ, làm rung chuyển thế giới võ thuật. Trác Nhất Hàng đối mặt với cô nhưng lại yêu. Khi anh chuẩn bị kết hôn với người khác, cô tóc bạc trắng và thề sẽ không bao giờ gặp lại.

programme.title: NỮ CẢNH SÁT ĐẶC NHIỆM - HIDDEN HEROINE
programme.desc: Một băng đảng ma túy đang cố thủ ở khu vực Đông Châu. Mei Jing thuộc Đơn vị biệt kích nữ Thunderbolt, dẫn đầu nhóm của cô tấn công cơ sở ma túy, nhưng họ đang bị phục kích và danh tính nội gián của cha Mei bị lộ. Sau một trận chiến khốc liệt, Mei và nhóm của cô đã đánh bại thành công băng đảng ma túy và giải cứu cha cô.

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: GIAO KÈO BÉO BỞ - A GOOD DEAL
programme.desc: Bị bắt cóc bởi một cặp vợ chồng tuyệt vọng, doanh nhân Burks Hill buộc phải thực hiện một hành trình điên cuồng đến Los Angeles. Khi nguy hiểm ngày càng gia tăng, ba du khách phát hiện ra rằng mỗi người họ đều ẩn chứa những bí mật chết người. Những gì bắt đầu từ một vụ bắt cóc đơn giản đã biến thành một trò chơi chết chóc mà không ai có thể sống sót.

programme.title: TAY ĐẤM HUYỀN THOẠI - FIST OF LEGEND
programme.desc: Khi Chen Zhen học ở Nhật Bản, anh phát hiện một số sinh viên Trung Quốc mất tích và vô tình phát hiện ra âm mưu của Hội Rồng Đen. Một loại thuốc mới được phát minh để tăng cường sức khỏe cho quân đội Nhật Bản trong chiến tranh và các sinh viên Trung Quốc được sử dụng trong thí nghiệm của họ. Chen Zhen thề sẽ tiêu diệt tổ chức tà ác và phá hủy phòng thí nghiệm bí mật của chúng.

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
programme.desc: Một chương trình thực tế vui nhộn kể về bốn nam nhân vật nổi tiếng đến từ các quốc gia khác nhau trong một kỳ nghỉ giả tưởng được đài thọ toàn bộ chi phí ở Hồng Kông, được thiết kế riêng cho các “anh em”!

Vì Khỉ Macaque sáu tai cũng muốn có sức mạnh của thời gian nên chúng đụng độ nhau trong một trận chiến khốc liệt…
